source_corrections: Theorem 3 needs a p-transversal existence hypothesis for its base-family conclusion.
Theorem 9 is false as printed; its formula and prose address different containment directions.
Theorem 13 is false as printed; full rank of a k-transversal only guarantees that it contains a p-transversal base.
Theorem 6 requires k>=1 unless the original matroid has rank zero.
Theorem 11 needs cardinality bars and a direct partition-matroid independence definition.
Theorems 12-13 require the recorded bars, bound variable, and label repairs.
